Figure 1: Strict M2 label/property routing on BACE and BBBP. Content sensitivity is correct minus deranged test content; head specificity is the expected graph head minus the best wrong head. Bars show paired mean nDCG differences and error bars show 95% hierarchical seed/query bootstrap intervals.

Figure 2: Canonical versus OOD trade-off for paraphrase interventions. Horizontal and vertical error bars are 95% hierarchical bootstrap intervals. The shaded upper-right region satisfies canonical change ≥ −0.02 and targeted OOD change > 0. The OOD axis uses held-out ordinary paraphrases for Phase 2D/2E and the separately locked fresh-hard set for Phase 2F-P; it should be read as an intervention-relative target, not as one shared test set.
